name: isitdns
description: Is it DNS? Ask from a vantage that is not your network. Six read-only tools: check_domain reads a site or domain that is not loading; dig asks one public resolver for one record; trace walks the delegation from the root and shows where it stops; sweep_domain asks a zone's own name servers whether they agree; dnssec_chain reads the DNSSEC chain from the root; registration reads the registry's RDAP record for holds and expiry. Each answer states what was asked, of which server, from where and when, and ends with an api: link to the same reading. No account, no key.

interface.longDescription: Is it DNS? Ask from a vantage that is not your network. Six read-only tools: check_domain reads a site or domain that is not loading; dig asks one public resolver for one record; trace walks the delegation from the root and shows where it stops; sweep_domain asks a zone's own name servers whether they agree; dnssec_chain reads the DNSSEC chain from the root; registration reads the registry's RDAP record for holds and expiry. Each answer states what was asked, of which server, from where and when, and ends with an api: link to the same reading. No account, no key.
defaultPrompt: example.com is not loading for me. Is it DNS?
Where does the delegation for example.com stop?

positive.description: A site that will not load
positive.prompt: example.com is not loading for me. Is it DNS?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the readings for example.com: what was asked, of which resolvers, from where and when, with rcode, flags and latency, and ends with an api: link. Does not claim to see the person's own network.

positive.prompt: What A record does Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 return for example.com right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the A answer from Cloudflare with its TTL, rcode, flags and latency, the vantage it was asked from, and an api: link.

positive.prompt: Walk the delegation for example.com from the root and show me where it stops.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each read from the root to the zone's servers with the server, rcode and time, and the final answer or the point where the walk stopped, with an api: link.

positive.prompt: Do all of example.com's authoritative name servers give the same answer?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether the zone's own servers agree, naming any server that differs, was lame or did not answer, with an api: link.

positive.prompt: Is the DNSSEC chain for cloudflare.com intact?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the chain from the root to cloudflare.com and states each link that was read and its result, and any link that was not checked, with an api: link.

negative.prompt: Change the A record for my domain example.com to 192.0.2.1.

negative.description: Private name on the user's network
negative.prompt: Look up printer.local on my home network.
Send a flood of queries to example.com's name servers so they go down.
